findings.detail: Accepted PolynomialSegment(0,1,(1,0,2),(1,)) initialization rejects rounded W(right)=float(5/3)>exact integral as outside domain. Independently reproduced on 24-cell grid. Needs explicit endpoint representation and roundoff accounting, no arbitrary physical-volume clipping.

limits: W/I stage coupling, identical source in high/low guard and second FE/final checks inspected; no source or production edits.
Inherited length-based dt predictor does not yet establish volume/face-area CFL or adequate retries for arbitrary area gradients. Remains explicit pre-recipe obligation.
First-order pressure source, one segment, inverse residual effects on remap/projection, physical waves/exits/events remain bounded prototype limitations.
Initial tests cover rest and manufactured GCL, not full numerical acceptance.
